Aupaka : m. (pl.): Name of a people.

Listed by Saṁjaya among the northern peoples of the Bhāratavarṣa (uttarāś cāpare mlecchā janā bharatasattama) 6. 10. 63; (aupakāś ca kaliṅgāś ca) 6. 10. 67.
